# Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC): Complete Guide, Templates & Tools

> Free, open-source collection of SDLC guides, Markdown templates, SVG/PNG diagrams, checklists, examples, and browser tools maintained by Developer Assistants.

- Repository: https://github.com/developer-assistants/awesome-sdlc
- Live site: https://developer-assistants.github.io/awesome-sdlc/

## Guides
- [SDLC Guide](https://developer-assistants.github.io/awesome-sdlc/): Overview, interactive checklist preview, and model comparison.
- [SDLC Meaning](https://developer-assistants.github.io/awesome-sdlc/meaning/): Definition, history, defect cost curve, roles, SSDLC, and SDLC vs STLC vs PDLC.
- [SDLC Phases](https://developer-assistants.github.io/awesome-sdlc/phases/): All seven phases with deliverables, SSDLC gates, pitfalls, and DORA metrics.
- [SDLC Models](https://developer-assistants.github.io/awesome-sdlc/models/): Waterfall, Agile, V-Model, Spiral, Iterative, RAD, DevOps, plus interactive Model Selector.
- [SDLC Examples](https://developer-assistants.github.io/awesome-sdlc/examples/): Real-world SaaS, REST API, medical firmware, and offline mobile app walkthroughs.
- [Agile SDLC](https://developer-assistants.github.io/awesome-sdlc/agile/): SDLC vs Agile, Scrum vs Kanban vs XP, DoR/DoD, metrics, and anti-patterns.
- [Waterfall SDLC](https://developer-assistants.github.io/awesome-sdlc/waterfall/): Stage gates, CCB, strengths, failure modes, and Water-Scrum-Fall hybrid.
- [SDLC Cheat Sheet](https://developer-assistants.github.io/awesome-sdlc/cheat-sheet/): Printable reference with DORA benchmarks and RACI matrix.

## Interactive Tools
- [SDLC Checklist Generator](https://developer-assistants.github.io/awesome-sdlc/checklist/): Track 7-phase progress across 5 presets and export Markdown.
- [SDLC Diagram Generator](https://developer-assistants.github.io/awesome-sdlc/diagram/): Generate and download SVG, PNG, and Mermaid diagrams across 6 models.
- [SDLC Template Builder](https://developer-assistants.github.io/awesome-sdlc/templates/): Customize and download 8 engineering Markdown templates (PRD, SRS, ADD, ADR, Security, Test Plan, Runbook, Post-Mortem).
- [SDLC Interview Questions & Quiz](https://developer-assistants.github.io/awesome-sdlc/interview-questions/): 15-question interactive quiz and 16-item Q&A bank.
